walkthroughs.body_html:
pV = constant at constant T.

p1 V1 = p2 V2.
Squeeze gas quickly -> work done -> internal energy rises -> T rises.

Energy input goes into breaking bonds (PE).

Temperature constant during state change.

mcqs.q: During boiling, energy is used to:
What did Rutherford's alpha-scattering experiment show about the atom?
options: Most of the atom is empty space, with a tiny dense positive nucleus.
It showed that atoms are solid spheres of positive charge with electrons embedded inside.
The net force equals the velocity times the mass of the object.
It showed that alpha particles can pass through any material because they are massless.

mcqs.q: If an object is moving at constant velocity in a straight line, what is the net force on it?
options: Zero — by Newton's first law, constant velocity requires zero net force.
There must be a forward force on the object to keep it moving.
Kinetic energy stays the same because mass hasn't changed.
The net force equals the velocity times the mass of the object.

mcqs.q: If a car doubles its speed, what happens to its kinetic energy?
options: Kinetic energy doubles because energy is proportional to speed.
Kinetic energy stays the same because mass hasn't changed.
It quadruples (because KE = 1/2 mv^2 — kinetic energy is proportional to v^2).
It showed that alpha particles can pass through any material because they are massless.
